P01.rationale: There is no founder portrait or human anchor on this page; it relies entirely on typography and abstract data.

P05.rationale: The case study lacks a framed client portrait, instead using only generic text blocks to describe the situation.

P07.rationale: A single statistic (58%) is present as a data point, but it does not constitute a social-proof apparatus like a press wall or review grid.

P10.rationale: The page features oversized decorative typography ('Kommunikation skaliert nicht durch Köpfe') that acts as a visual anchor and headline element.

P11.rationale: A specific data visualization is present in the form of a large percentage (58%) with a clear context label below it.

P12.rationale: The layout reads as a dense, magazine-quality editorial spread that fills the sheet with text and typographic elements.

P13.rationale: The background is a flat, solid dark blue color without any intentional texture or atmospheric treatment.

P14.rationale: There are no full-bleed photos on this page to evaluate for text readability treatments.

P16.rationale: No device or product mockup is shown; the design relies solely on typographic hierarchy and layout structure.

N07.rationale: The imagery consists entirely of abstract typography and data points rather than specific business photography.

N08.rationale: There is minimal dead whitespace; the page is densely packed with text columns and a central statistic.

N10.rationale: Text sits on a flat background without any busy photo interference or awkward inset gaps.
